reviewItem.question: For "Update AMIFamily for non-AL2023 AMIs (#6638) #6638 (Amanuel Engeda)", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

exposure.needed: whether the AMIs the environment's node classes resolve to are non-AL2023 (the resolved AMI identities behind the environment's AMI selection are not visible in static configuration)

proposed.statement: Karpenter v1.0.0 updates AMIFamily for non-AL2023 AMIs (bugfix #6638), so environments that use non-AL2023 AMIs will see changed AMIFamily handling after upgrading.
